description:
Composition & Indication

Adapalene 0.3% Gel — 30 g Tube (Generic for Differin®) contains Adapalene 0.3% (3 mg/g) as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 g Tube at the official 0.3% topical gel strength. The standard indication is the management of acne vulgaris topical therapy, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Adapalene 0.3% Gel is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.

CMC Pharmacy Cabo Service

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1). Please consult your healthcare provider before use. Authentic product sourced from licensed Mexican distributors. Same-day delivery to Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, and the Los Cabos tourist corridor. Bilingual customer support available 24/7 for visitors and residents.
